name: CalcMaster One
description:
All in one Calculator is a fast, clean and easy to use calculator for everyday needs.

Features:
• Standard calculations: add, subtract, multiply and divide
• Simple, distraction-free interface
• Works offline, no internet needed
• Lightweight and quick to open
• Works on Windows PCs, laptops and tablets

Whether you are at school, work or home, All in one Calculator gives you quick answers without clutter.
